test_converters_type_validation: test that converters parameter must be a dict and raises TypeError for non-dict input
test_converters_basic_application: test applying a converter function to a CSV column using dateutil.parser.parse
test_converters_no_implicit_conversion: test that converters prevent implicit numeric casting and preserve object dtype
test_converters_euro_decimal_format: test parsing European-style comma decimal numbers using custom converter functions
test_converters_corner_with_nans: test converters handling NaN values, range parsing, and plus-sign increment logic
test_converter_index_col_identity: test applying a converter to an index column preserves string values in the index
test_converter_identity_object: test that identity converter lambda x: x keeps column values as object dtype
test_converter_multi_index: test applying converters to multi-level column headers with tuple keys
